summary: Backend multi-session auth fix (Phase 2, 2026-06-27) FULLY VERIFIED. All 7 test scenarios PASS against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The user-reported bug ('logging into web kicks out the APK') is resolved: two concurrent logins under the same account now both stay valid; single-device logout no longer affects the other device; refresh-token rotation cleanly swaps the caller's sid without disturbing other sessions; the 10-slot cap correctly evicts the oldest sessions when exceeded; explicit logout keeps the revoked session dead even after a third login; and a forged no-sid (legacy) access token is rejected once the user has a populated active_session_ids array. Google OAuth path (/auth/google/exchange line 568-571) calls register_session identically to email login — verified by code review.

minor.issue: server.py line 415 mints an access token WITHOUT sid that is immediately overwritten on line 425. Dead/wasted call — harmless but should be removed for clarity.
Comment at server.py lines 416-420 still says 'Single-session enforcement' though the behaviour is now multi-session. Stale doc-comment, no functional impact.
MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER is a module constant; docstring claims it can be 'lifted via env' but no env override exists. Cosmetic — fine for now.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Remove the redundant sid-less create_access_token call at server.py:415 — the next line replaces it.
(Optional cleanup) Update the stale 'Single-session enforcement' comment block (server.py lines 416-420) to reflect multi-session semantics.
(Optional) Make MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER env-driven (e.g. os.environ.get('MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER', 10)) as the docstring implies.
critical_code_review_comments: revoke_session uses two queries (pull then conditional unset) — non-atomic but race window is benign (logout vs concurrent refresh on the same sid).
rotate_session = pull(old) + register_session(new). Briefly puts the slot count at N-1 before pushing back; safe.
get_current_user behaviour matrix exactly matches the documented spec including legacy single-sid grandfather path.
All three login paths (register, email login, google exchange) consistently call register_session with a freshly minted sid. ✓

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG: User document held a single `active_session_id` string; every login overwrote it; the FIRST device's JWT then failed `token.sid == user.active_session_id` in get_current_user → 401 session_revoked → forced logout on the older device. FIX VERIFIED: `active_session_ids: List[str]` (Mongo $push $each $slice -10) authoritatively holds up to 10 concurrent device sids; login adds, logout pulls only the caller's sid, refresh rotates one slot. Behaviour matrix in get_current_user handles new-array, legacy-scalar grandfather, and legacy-no-sid grandfather paths cleanly. All 7 tests green against the production-style preview URL.
